posts.body:
Enemy Actor Version 1.0
VSMA
​
Feature
Have enemies that behave like main characters
How to Use
First, make a new enemy as usual, his sprite is not important, it's will be replaced
by a sv_actor
Then in the parameters of the plug-in:
- open the parameter enemy actors
- add a new element and fill in the parameters
- enemy: the is of enemy you made
- sv_actor: the sv_actor that will replace the enemy's sprite
- weapon : the id of a weapon. It's will be use only for the
Demo
Download
link:
https://github.com/VSMA909/EnemyActorRPGMMZ

Sorry took a while, computer had to get serviced. Anyway, I tried it with the fanatic enemy and it worked fine. I copy and pasted the .png into the sv_actors file, and made sure it was named correctly. With the full 6x9, you can just named it Fanatic or whatever. posts.author: Reheel
posts.body: Does anyone have the problem I am having using this free SV animated enemy plugin? The enemies have their status buffs/debuffs shown backward or in reverse. Anyone know how this can be fix? I am just starting on RPG MAKER MZ and taking a javascript crash course. Any help or advice is much appreciated.

posts.author: GreenOx97
posts.body:

Does anyone have the problem I am having using this free SV animated enemy plugin? The enemies have their status buffs/debuffs shown backward or in reverse. Anyone know how this can be fix? I am just starting on RPG MAKER MZ and taking a javascript crash course. Any help or advice is much appreciated.
View attachment 324449
Click to expand...
Yeah, I've have the same thing happening to me. I haven't been concerned, since I figured it was to do with the fact that the plugin flips the spritesheets, and so subsequently the buff icons are flipped as well.
My plan was just to simply create flipped versions of the icons, duplicate the states (Attack Up, Defense Up, etc)  in the States tab, put the flipped icons in those ones, and then modify the enemy's skills so the duplicated state is applied instead with the icon now facing the right way.
In the case of Defense Down, I suppose I'd have to do that with the Actor's skills instead.
It's not a perfect solution, because if it's not towards an enemy that's using the plugin, the icon will stay flipped. But as I said, I haven't really been worried about it, so I haven't spent much time thinking on this. But it could be a starting point for you.
If you find a better way, let me know.
